conclusions: Same4a zero and C172544 have exactly equal recorded actual initial state; their sourceN Full12 is equal on all723 common ticks. OldC171520 has equal initial state and sourceN on all693 common ticks, but different policy contract/head and weights.

C172544 still cancels positive sourceN on FL/FR/RL while enhancing RR: target-level RR-dominant positive command is confirmed. It is not proven exclusive RR traction, appropriate support cooperation, or a unique cause of knee collapse.

Tick400 measured native wheel qd and physical canonical qd match exact sign conversion; all fresh height-row comparisons are exact. SourceN, residual-only projection, finalnative allfour composition have no detected omission or unit/sign/mask-target mismatch.

These thresholds are descriptive. Zero lowers base earlier23 and has no >=1deg RR error persisting12ticks in this prefix, so lowering alone is not failure evidence.

New C tick723 still has FR current gap+.3197mm but frontdistance−.1810m and no crossing/placement; its hardlimit failure is not contingent on a negative FR topgap. Original zero full success8857 is preserved.

Both C variants change all12 from tick1 relative to zero. Between old/new C, tick1 wheel final targets are identical but servo targets and physical response already differ; cannot attribute first divergence to changed wheel targets alone.
